note: Primitive campground along the Androscoggin River in the Thirteen Mile Woods Scenic Area, ~3 mi south of Errol on NH-16. Mostly tent and pop-up sites plus 2 lean-tos and 2 remote canoe-to sites; only the 2 'standard' drive-in sites take a 23-ft rig: 018, a back-in on the open lawn by the river, and 029, a pull-through set back from the water. A new office and camp store are open; the new showers and flush toilets were still delayed by construction when the park page was read (2026-11-23). Wood, ice and canoe/kayak rentals at the office. Every camper registers at the office (self-registration when closed); payment at the park is cash or traveler's check only. --Claude
summary: Park page, 2/2026 info sheet, 10-2026 schedule and the full RA catalog read. Confirmed $29 primitive, no hookups, pit toilets + water, camp store; sites 44 (RA lists 42), max_rig_ft 25 (only 018 back-in and 029 pull-through take over 16 ft), season May 24-Oct 11 (2026). New showers/flush toilets delayed by construction, not written. Riverfront kept: site 018 (25 ft) RA 'Riverfront' on open lawn ~20 m from the river.
flags: FIT (thin): the agency calls it a 'primitive tenting campground' with '44 tent sites'; only 2 of 44 sites take a rig over 16 ft (RA 'Standard' 018 Back-In 25 ft, 029 Pull-Through 25 ft). A 23-ft rig fits those two only. Kept per the stored inclusion evidence; a human may judge whether two sites is enough.

WATERFRONT riverfront kept (borderline): RA marks 018 'Proximity to Water: Riverfront'; GIS point 44.73943,-71.14346 sits on an open mown lawn about 15-20 m from the Androscoggin with only a narrow brushy bank fringe between (Esri). 029 (44.73796,-71.14401) is not marked riverfront and sits ~25 m back behind riverfront tent sites 030-032. All other riverfront sites (019, 020, 023, 026, 027, 030-040, 042) are 10-16 ft. If the bank fringe at 018 is read as a tree line, this becomes river view.

FACILITIES conflict: the 2/2026 info sheet says 'A camp store, flush toilets, showers, and dishwashing stations are located at the visitor center', but the park page says the new showers and flush toilets are delayed ('will not be available until later this season') and RA still says 'There are no showers or flush toilets'. flush_toilets/showers left unwritten.
SEASON: the schedule's 5/24 is the Sunday of Memorial Day weekend 2026; RA shows 2027 opening Fri May 28. Stored derived 05-22/10-14 replaced by 05-24/10-11.
